clue.text: Change solution found on typewriter

parts.note: to change is to shift, as in shifting position
a key is the solution to a puzzle, as in an answer key

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a substitute answer typed out on an old typewriter.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is descriptive rather than a synonym: the answer is a part found on any typewriter keyboard.
explanation.definitionFit: The capitals key on a typewriter or keyboard is a standard part of the machine.

clue.text: Wintry hail-storm going round Swiss capital

indicators.note: going round tells us the scrambled letters surround the Swiss capital
a storm whirls things about, so the letters of hail are tossed into a new order

parts.note: Bern is the capital of Switzerland

explanation.surface: A hailstorm swirls around the Swiss capital in midwinter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hail-storm' looks like one weather word, but 'storm' is the anagram signal acting on its first half, giving HIAL for 'going round' to wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective comes from the Latin for winter, describing anything of the cold season.

clue.text: Experience poverty — or a clumsy pickpocket?

definitions.meaning: to suffer a shortage of money, an idiom for hard times
read literally, a pickpocket so clumsy that the victim notices the fingers nipping at them

explanation.surface: Being poor compared with being a thief whose light-fingered touch is all too noticeable.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be short of money; literally it describes sensing a nip, as a victim would from an inept thief.

clue.text: Film about one bear

indicators.note: about means the film brand goes around the letter for one

parts.note: Kodak is a famous make of photographic film
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A nature documentary about a single bear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I inside KODAK.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a very large brown bear species native to the islands of Alaska.

clue.text: On the way up controlling influence deviates

indicators.note: in a down entry, being on the way up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: sway is power or controlling influence, as in holding sway

explanation.surface: An ambitious person's dominance wavers as they climb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the way up' turns SWAY into the answer; this works because it is a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship or aircraft that swings off its straight course is said to do this.

clue.text: Tailless bear going before Edward made whimpering sounds

indicators.note: without its tail means the last letter of the bear's name is dropped

parts.note: the grizzly is a North American bear
Ed is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: A bear with no tail walks ahead of a man called Edward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going before' is the charade signal placing the shortened bear ahead; 'grizzled' usually means grey-haired, but here it is the verb grizzle.
explanation.definitionFit: To grizzle is British informal for a child's fretful crying or whining, so this is its past tense.

clue.text: Charge one to travel in it

parts.note: a tax is a charge levied on people
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: Someone is billed for a single ride.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a vehicle you pay to travel in.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab is a hired vehicle that passengers ride in for a fare.

clue.text: Kindly society?

definitions.meaning: kindly means warm and well-disposed towards others
a British mutual association for sickness and savings benefit is called a ... society

explanation.surface: Asking whether a group of people is kind.
explanation.walkthrough: A friendly society is a British mutual organisation whose members pay in for insurance against illness or old age; the question mark marks the shortened name.
explanation.definitionFit: The first is a plain synonym for warm and amiable; the second names the British mutual-benefit club by its first word.

clue.text: From one highflier to another

parts.note: highflier suggests an ambitious person, but here it is an aircraft in flight, and the phrase describes something passing between two of them

explanation.definitionFit: The term describes missiles or communication passing between two aircraft in flight.

clue.text: Cleric, not Kelvin, cooking kebab

indicators.note: not tells us the letter for Kelvin must be taken away from the fodder
cooking a dish transforms it, so the letters of kebab are rearranged

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin, the unit of temperature

explanation.surface: A priest cooks a kebab, though without a man named Kelvin.
explanation.walkthrough: Take K (Kelvin) out of KEBAB, as 'not' asks, and 'cooking' shuffles the remaining EBAB into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the French title for a priest or abbot, used in English for a French cleric.

clue.text: Non-interference over the channel

parts.note: channel suggests television, but it is the English Channel: across it in France, the phrase for letting things be

explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means let do, a policy of the state leaving markets alone.

clue.text: Extremely necessary for everybody to bring in a set of books

parts.note: all means everybody
to import is to bring goods in from abroad
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Bringing in a full collection of books is vital for everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: NT, the New Testament, is a crossword staple for a set of books.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of the utmost significance is crucial or vital.

clue.text: Mistakenly shun one with Kenneth who is resolute

indicators.note: done mistakenly means put in the wrong order, so the letters of shun are rearranged

parts.note: a means one
Ken is a short form of the name Kenneth

explanation.surface: Someone wrongly snubs a determined man called Kenneth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mistakenly' gives UNSH; 'who is' is a link leading to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone firm and determined is not shaken or wavering.

clue.text: New book

definitions.meaning: a long fictional story published as a book

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means fresh and original; as a noun it is a long work of fiction.

clue.text: Lulu almost came first — having become calm

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the name is not reached

parts.note: led means came first, as in led the race

explanation.surface: The singer Lulu nearly won a contest and is now relaxed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims LULU to LUL; then LED. Lulu is a Scottish pop singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something soothed into quiet has been calmed or quietened.

clue.text: Fall into error

explanation.surface: Someone tumbles into making a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it is to lose one's footing and fall; as a noun it is a minor mistake.

clue.text: Soldiers' vehicle? Force members to use it

definitions.meaning: read literally, a car for a squad of soldiers
members of the police force patrol in it

explanation.surface: An order to make the troops ride in a military vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Force' looks like a verb meaning compel, but it is the police force.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a police patrol car; read literally, it is a car for a squad, a small unit of soldiers.

clue.text: Bright boy stayed out of sight as a cockney might have said

parts.note: Viv is a short form of the boy's name Vivian

indicators.text: as a cockney might have said
indicators.note: a cockney speaker drops the H at the start of words

parts.note: hid means stayed out of sight

explanation.surface: A clever lad hid away, speaking in London dialect.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, drop initial H, so 'as a cockney might have said' turns HID into ID.
explanation.definitionFit: Vivid colours are intense and brilliant.

clue.text: Peer against old imperial official one's included

indicators.note: included means the letters for one's sit inside the other pieces

parts.note: v, short for versus, means against
a count, from the Latin comes, was an official of the Roman Empire
one's is I plus S, short for one is

explanation.surface: An aristocrat is set against an ancient imperial officer who has been let in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' is read as one + 's, the short form of 'one is'; 'included' sets it between the two other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the nobility ranking above a baron and below an earl.

clue.text: Wed heartless lady

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: to wed is to marry

explanation.surface: Someone weds a cold-hearted woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' removes the central R of MARRY.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's first name serves as an example of a lady.

clue.text: Check filter again first

indicators.note: first places the letters for again at the front

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
to strain is to filter, as through a sieve

explanation.surface: An instruction to check something, then put it through the sieve a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' puts RE ahead of STRAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To curb or hold back is to keep in check.

clue.text: You reportedly hurried with us to find heavenly body

indicators.note: reportedly means the word is as heard spoken

parts.note: the word you sounds like the letter U
ran means hurried
taken as written

explanation.surface: Hurrying with friends to see a star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' turns YOU into the letter U, which sounds the same.
explanation.definitionFit: The seventh planet from the Sun is a celestial body.

clue.text: The French included an angry game

indicators.note: included means the other pieces are put inside the French article

parts.note: le is the French word for the
a means an
cross means angry

explanation.surface: The French joined in, becoming furious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included' looks like it applies to 'an angry', but it is the French article that holds them.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a field sport played with netted sticks.

clue.text: Entering tabernacle, Richard priest

indicators.note: entering signals that the answer is found inside the run of words tabernacle and Richard

explanation.surface: A clergyman named Richard goes into a tabernacle.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman or churchman is a minister such as a priest.

clue.text: Removal of bishop from the highest seat in the land?

definitions.text: Removal of bishop from the highest seat in the land?

parts.words: Removal of bishop from the highest seat in the land?
parts.note: bishop suggests a churchman, but as in chess it stands for a figure of power, and the highest seat in the land is the crown's chair; the clue describes deposing its holder

explanation.definitionFit: It means deposing a ruler, taking a monarch off the throne.

clue.text: A hit production in an eastern language

indicators.note: a production is something made, so the letters of A hit are reworked

explanation.surface: A hit show staged in an Asian tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'production' rearranges A HIT.
explanation.definitionFit: The official language of Thailand in Southeast Asia.

clue.text: Impetuosity of men not starting to go round Louisiana

indicators.note: to go round means the shortened word surrounds the abbreviation
not starting means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: LA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Louisiana

explanation.surface: Men are reluctant to set off on a journey around Louisiana.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not starting' leaves EN, which 'to go round' wraps about the state abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash and vigorous spirit, a borrowing from French.

clue.text: Not completely open — that's a shock

parts.note: a jar is a jolt or shock

explanation.surface: Finding a door left slightly open comes as a surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left slightly open is partly closed rather than wide.

clue.text: Huntress, one entering Georgian city

indicators.note: entering means the letter for one goes inside the city

parts.note: Atlanta is the capital of the US state of Georgia
a means one

explanation.surface: One person enters an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts A into ATLANTA after its first two letters. Georgia here is the US state, not the country.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth she was a swift-footed huntress who raced her suitors.

clue.text: New notice in reverse first for killer weed

indicators.note: first puts the turned-round word at the front
in reverse means the little word is read backwards
new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of notice

explanation.surface: A fresh warning reversing an earlier one about a deadly plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges NOTICE into COTINE; 'in reverse' gives NI, which 'first' puts at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: The addictive, poisonous alkaloid found in tobacco, the weed that kills smokers.
